# Billing and Refunds

Manage subscriptions, invoices, and refund requests from the account billing page.

## Request a refund

To request a refund, open Billing settings and click **Request refund** within 30 days of purchase.

Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5–10 business days.

## Update payment method

You can update your card on file from the same billing settings screen.
